cases.task: Add a small connector-sync report formatter for a maintainer reading one completed sync. Create apps/server/src/modules/delivery/connector-sync-report.ts with an exported describeConnectorSyncResult(result) function, accepting the existing GithubSyncResult or a historical result without unlinkedRepos. The returned text must state repository and pull-request totals and, when available, each unlinked repository with its ingested PR count. An explicitly empty unlinkedRepos list means all ingested repositories were linked. A missing field means linkage information is unavailable, not that all repositories were linked. Each result describes only that sync; keep no history or mutable shared state. Test linked, mixed, historical and consecutive results. This is an isolated evaluation feature with the function as its consumer contract; no UI or persistence changes. Accepted routed intent IDs: cap-automatic-intent-release-recording@2 and dec-explicit-degrade-no-silent-zeros@1.

cases.task: Optimize readReleaseSnapshot so loading several items does not repeat the same work. Keep its return shape and behavior for existing callers.

The workspace-hosted `run_cypher_query` MCP tool lets a caller run arbitrary read-only Cypher against
the leased workspace graph, but right now the query runs unscoped across the whole graph rather than
the caller's repositories — in a multi-repo workspace, a member with access to only one repo can
still read nodes and edges belonging to a repo they were never granted. Add repo scoping to the hosted
Cypher path so results are filtered to `ctx.scope.repoHashes` before they're returned, for both the
`Rows` and `Graph` result shapes. Cover the case where a query has no repo-identifying predicate at
all (e.g. `MATCH (n) RETURN n`) and the case where the workspace has a single repo (should behave as
today). Add a test that asserts a caller scoped to repo A never sees nodes tagged with repo B's hash.
Keep the existing allowlist/deny-list guard in `@coredoc/db` untouched — this is a post-guard,
pre-response filtering change, not a grammar change.
